comment: Upstream provenance for every OpenChamber patch in the queue. `relationship` says what an upstream release would mean for this patch: same (we shipped this change, or upstream did), alternative (upstream shipped a different design for the same need, so the patch needs reconciling rather than porting), partial (upstream took part of it), pending (a PR or issue is open and nothing has shipped), none (local only, no upstream counterpart). `mergedAs` is the merge commit when one exists. `intent` says what the patch deserves upstream: bugfix (a broken thing upstream owns), feature, personal (stays local), testing (wants more use before deciding) or declined (the maintainer refused it). `since` is the date this record was last checked. Update this file whenever a patch is added, dropped or re-expressed; scripts/openchamber-upstream.sh fails when a queued patch has no record here. `follows` lists the earlier patches whose own lines this patch rewrites; scripts/assert-openchamber-patch-overlap.mjs fails a patch that rewrites another patch's lines without listing it. `retired` records patches that left the queue: same (upstream carries it, with the pr and mergedAs) or alternative (upstream shipped another design), with the content evidence in the note.

chat-width-80.note: A fourth chat width, Extra wide (80rem), between Wider and Full. Upstream owns the setting now (default/wider/full, migrated in v29); this re-expresses the 80rem level on top of it. Kept indefinitely by Jeremy's choice.

commandcode-quota.note: Local-only provider. Upstream removed Command Code quota in 1.21.0 (its official API exposes no usage data) and declined to restore it; this reads the web app's own billing routes with a browser session token. Ported onto main's TypeScript provider module. Re-exported on e84d59b after upstream removed the Google and Antigravity quota providers (d09cb7c9b) from the same registry.

dictation-recovery.note: Upstream #7532 merged the origin-keying half and #7543 the Dictate shortcut, so the dictate-link flow left this patch with mobile-voice-launch. What stays is absent at e69cbb8: a finish with no text (nothing recorded, or no speech) and a microphone that never started are failures on screen instead of a silent return to idle, Retry shows only when there is audio to replay, a capture silent for six seconds says so while recording, cancel works from the failed state, and a two-action banner toast wraps its buttons. An empty recording also closes its server stream, as 51751fa8a's every-way-out rule requires.

draft-heading-project-picker.note: The project's name in a new-session heading is a second way into the composer's project picker. Kept indefinitely by Jeremy's choice, and going upstream: a feature request plus a PR are being prepared. On e69cbb8 the target wraps #7639's name span, which keeps its trailing punctuation glued to the name, so the line still does not break between them.

gitea-references-across.note: The reference picker's search across a folder's repositories for Gitea and Forgejo, which have no API that names a set of repositories: a page is read per folder and merged by activity. 48 files. Ported onto main's provider-resource contract (referencesAcross in the descriptor, provider and routes) and its TypeScript settings/client modules.

hide-empty-worktrees.note: A worktree nobody has used yet (no session, no draft, no pin, no archived session) can be left out of the sidebar. A search still finds it. Re-expressed on e69cbb8: it reads the archive anchors from worktreeArchive.anchors, and #7599's dated list leaves a hidden worktree out too. Local: the setting is ours.

image-viewer-zoom.note: Pinch, double-tap and wheel zoom with pan for the image viewer, on top of upstream's fit levels. Ported onto main's imageZoom module and ToolOutputDialog. The old record cited PR #321, which does not resolve in the upstream repository, and no open issue covers it, so a feature request has to exist before this can go upstream.

in-work-paging.note: In work ranks its rows by what needs the user (a waiting answer, then a running turn, then unread or looks-done) from the live turn and request indexes only, so a recency update does not re-run it, and holds its order under the pointer or focus. Upstream still orders In work by time at e69cbb8; the ranking now wraps getTimeOrderedSessions() and keeps 9c3e16c45's pinnedInWork rule. Local.

in-work-paging-show-more.note: In work opens with its own page size (a stored per-surface number) and Show more adds the same number again, separate from the sidebar's session batch size. Kept for now.

instance-attention.note: Cross-instance attention: desktop and mobile poll the saved hosts and the app's own server and show one merged, ordered list of sessions that need the user. Nothing like it is upstream at e69cbb8. Kept: Jeremy will upstream it once he is happy with it. Folds in its fixes, which go upstream with it: the drawer applied this instance's folder rule to a saved host's sessions; a host switch cleared the session list so the instance on screen published no rows; a question tool call that ends in error sends no settlement, so both halves check a pending form against OpenCode's own form list (settleGlobalBlockingRequest lives here now, ahead of every patch that calls it); and a click in the attention dialog opens the clicked session after the host switch lands instead of the one last open there.

pdf-viewer-zoom.note: Zoom for the pdf.js fallback where the runtime has no built-in PDF viewer (the Android WebView): the image viewer's controls, a two-finger pinch and Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, repainting pages at a capped canvas size. Builds on image-viewer-zoom. PR #7464 is open upstream work waiting on feature request #6113: the intake bot closed the PR until the request is accepted, and it reopens on its own when it is. The patch stays in the queue meanwhile.

question-cards.note: The card itself: every option with the chosen one marked, a typed answer as one more row, and a working turn's fold preview drawing the card in step order. The card draws the prompt bubble itself (message/body/userBubbleStyle.ts) with the question colour in its fill, and every card uses one shape. Folds in context-row-icons: the question line gets its own mark, so a question card no longer reads like a collapsed quote. On e69cbb8 the in-chat choice (questionsInChat) is optional and off by default, and the grouped rows read the same cuts. Issue #7108 closed as fixed by #7109, so a feature request is needed before this can be accepted upstream.

question-indicator.note: PR #7560 for issue #6809 was closed unmerged on 2026-11-26; its branch is kept identical to this diff so it reopens correct if #6809 is accepted. One component (SessionPendingMarks) draws the permission shield and the question mark, both in the warning colour (no question colour role of its own). Fixes the run page's lanes and the overview, which drew the permission red and the question in the running blue against multirun's own rule that blocked-state colours match the sidebar; LaneStatusIcon.test.tsx guards it. Rows keep #7603's clickable badges (PendingRequestBadges, MobileSessionPendingBadgeButtons); the plain marks, both session switchers and the collapsed group and folder headers use the shared component. Folds in the stale-pending-badge remainder that #7530 and #7603 did not take (issue #6802): a collapsed header counts pending requests from the directory store once it has read them and from the index before that (selectIndexedBlockingRequests), as #7603 does for rows. Based on v2.8.1 (1c08802), with its comments in the module docs so upstream's check:changed ratchet passes.

question-rows.note: A question call becomes its own row in the transcript instead of a tool row: answered ones stick under their prompt and end its sticky span, waiting ones read as a card. On e69cbb8 the cut also reaches 3761ef61f's Grouped activity mode, now the default: messageCuts gives a question its own piece in messagePieces and the grouped rows carry questionPartId. Issue #7108 closed as fixed by #7109, so a feature request is needed before this can be accepted upstream.

recap-full-note.note: A UI preference: the recap ends the transcript instead of lying over the gap above the composer, so the whole note stays readable. Kept indefinitely by Jeremy's choice. Ported onto main's ChatViewport listFooter.

reply-start-scroll.note: PR #7561 is open for issue #6808. The pill's up arrow walks back to the nearest reply whose prose starts above the viewport, past the tool rows that led to it. On e69cbb8 #7490 moved the follow stops to lib/scroll/followStops.ts; that file now takes REPLY_START_GAP_PX from this patch's scrollGaps.ts, so the follow stop and the arrow share one gap.

session-entry-position.note: A per-surface choice of where a session opens: the remembered position, the start of the last reply, or the conversation start. It reuses reply-start-scroll's reply start, and a session that is still working opens at its end. Issue #6808 covers the reply-start landing only; whether the entry-position choice belongs upstream is its call.

tray-instances.note: The desktop tray showed whichever window last pushed a snapshot, kept a closed window's rows, and answered Allow/Deny through the main window's instance. Main now keeps one snapshot per window, groups the menu by instance and routes every row to the window that supplied it. Also: an empty snapshot while a host switch loads, stale-runtime events dropped from global stores, a loaded directory's requests win over the global index, the tray and sidebar share one row rule, and revoking a desktop-local client from a remote window no longer touches this machine. On e69cbb8 the dock count keeps #7637's rule that a pinned chat listed in a shown pin section has a row with Chats hidden. Upstream plan: the bug fixes as a PR, the per-instance grouping as a feature request first.

attention-row-parity.note: The attention popover built another instance's rows with its own rule: it read only the wire parentID, so an operator child whose parent link lives in metadata, sitting in a /tmp/opencode worktree, was listed from cedar although navi's own sidebar and popover hid it. Both paths now call the sidebar's row rule with each instance's own data, and a failed or partial read shows sessions rather than hiding them. Builds on instance-attention, so it goes upstream with it.

catalog-refresh-in-use.note: Every running OpenCode location announces a config change, and the catalog refresh re-read agents, commands, providers and directory config for each one, so an OpenCode restart during the refresh booted every announcing location again. The refresh now reads only directories in use (current, viewed, bootstrap demand, active project, settings, the Projects page selection and the chats root) and invalidates the caches of the rest and marks their stores stale, so opening one re-reads it. Upstream's sync-catalog-refresh.ts is unchanged at e69cbb8. Also part of #7494. No upstream PR yet.

waiting-shortcut.note: The second app-icon quick action accepted feature request #6554 asked for (New session landed in #6566): Waiting on me opens openchamber://sessions?filter=attention, the link the iOS widget's attention entry already used, and the phone's session list now honours it by focusing on a section built from the sidebar's Waiting on me template (needs an answer or unread), with a chip that shows every session again. Written against plain e84d59b with no local patch underneath; upstream's check:changed passes on that branch. Android and shared UI ran here; the iOS quick action is written like New session's but not run (no Xcode). PR #7674 is open, sent after one day of use on a phone at Jeremy's call, with an Android emulator run, the instrumented launcher test and visual evidence; iOS is marked not run.

candidates.name: chat-small-image-upscale
candidates.note: The chat's tool-output dialog draws a picture larger than its own pixels at fit: a 64x64 icon renders near 1055%, where the files preview never upscales. No local patch yet.

retired.name: html-document-etag
retired.note: Merged upstream as #7631. e69cbb8's static-routes-runtime.ts sends every root HTML document with res.send (an ETag over its bytes), Cache-Control: no-cache and express.static index: false, the patch's behaviour; upstream also resolves encoded root-document paths, so its version is a superset.

retired.name: android-notification-dismiss
retired.note: Merged upstream as #6805. Opening a session clears its own phone banners and its subagents' (getSessionFamilyIds, clearNativeSessionNotifications in notification-store.ts), through a PushBanners plugin; the patch's notification-store hunks match e69cbb8 except upstream's added nativeSessionBannersAvailable gate.

retired.name: mobile-voice-launch
retired.note: Retired by decision. The patch made the BROWSABLE openchamber:// route honour dictate=1, so any app or web page could open a link that starts the microphone; #7543's merged design refuses a link that starts recording and ships an app-icon Dictate shortcut through the ShortcutRequests plugin instead, which is the supported path.

retired.name: mobile-assist-trigger
retired.note: Retired by decision with mobile-voice-launch: it rewrote ACTION_ASSIST (power-button hold) into the openchamber://new-session?dictate=1 link. Not re-expressed here; if the gesture is wanted back it should call DictateShortcut, which #7543's ShortcutRequests plugin hands to the page, with no link.
